parameters: \bArchie: Team Magma's Maxie got ahead\nof us, but we also got what we wanted.
\bThe Red Orb preserved at Mt. Pyre…\nI, Archie, now have it in my possession!
\bFufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate\nobjective to fruition!
\rNot only the Blue Orb, but even\nthe Red Orb has been taken…
\rThe Blue Orb and Red Orb must never\nbe separated. They belong together.
\rWhat are those men trying to do with\nthe two orbs?
\rOh, yes. Was it Team Magma who came\nand took the Blue Orb first?
\rWell, in their haste, they left this\nbehind.
\rI couldn't imagine what exactly it\ncould be.
\rI would like you to have it.\nPerhaps it will be useful in some way.
\bMt. Pyre is where we calm the spirits\nof Pokémon that have passed on…
\bThis is a high place where one can\nsee all of Hoenn…
\bThe disembodied spirits of Pokémon\nmust find solace here…
\bIs it coincidence that you are here…
\bWill you hear out my tale? A tale long\ntold in the Hoenn region?
\bThe world was wracked by a ferocious\nclash between the Pokémon of the land\nand the Pokémon of the sea…
\bThe Pokémon of the land raised\nmountains and created continents…
\bThe Pokémon of the sea raised huge\nwaves and carved out oceans…
\bThe world was engulfed in massive\ninfernos and vicious storms.
\bThe Blue Orb and the Red Orb brought\nan end to the calamity.
\bLight poured from the two orbs and\nbecalmed the enraged adversaries.
\bThe pair, made docile, dove deep into\nthe sea where eventually they\ndisappeared…
